_comment: Spec for sim_theorem_partii.py — reproduces the original hardcoded experiment exactly. k=3, diagonal-Gram case (G∞ = I_k). Effective spikes d_j = c_j·σ_j² = [0.040, 0.016, 0.006] satisfy Assumption 3 (strict decrease).
_beta_samplers_note: Per-factor loading samplers. For the diagonal-Gram case, draw β_j ~ N(0, c_j) so ‖β_j‖²/p → c_j and off-diagonal Gram entries vanish. scale_j = √c_j with c = [1.0, 0.8, 0.6].
